{{Quote|The planet is little more than an out of the way mining colony.|[[Wynn Dorvan]]|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Blaudu Sextus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which primarily served as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony to its inhabitants, which included [[Octusi]] [[Slavery/Legends|servants]]. In [[44 ABY]], the servants were priming for a [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]], and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] ordered for a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to quell the uprising.

==History==
{{Quote|Where are you heading next?''"<br />"''I'm not sure I should be telling you.''"<br />"''I would assume Klatooine. But that's not where the story is. If I were you, I would be heading for Blaudu Sextus.|Blink and Madhi Vaandt|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Bladudu Sextus was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that served as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony,<ref name="Allies" /> home to the [[Sextuna Mining Corporation]].<ref name="Vortex" /> The world allowed for the usage of [[Octusi]] [[Slavery/Legends|servants]], and also had a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force that was capable of handling minor protests; although the force was not strong enough to put down a full revolt. In [[44 ABY]], a freedom march was carried out for the slaves. When [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] heard about the incident, she ordered her [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], to contact [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Belok Rhal]] to hire a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of Mandalorians through the use of the mining company to stop the potential revolt. Meanwhile, [[Freedom Flight]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] anti-slavery organization, was aware of the situation. One Freedom Flight member, [[Blink]], tipped off [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] to go to Blaudu Sextus rather than [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], where [[Liberation|another uprising]] had recently begun.<ref name="Allies" />

Vaandt traveled to Blaudu Sextus, where Freedom Flight had initiated a [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolt]] among the pacifist Octusi [[Species/Legends|species]]. Vaandt reported on the revolt as Mandalorian troops arrived and responded to the Octusi with violence. Soon afterward, Belok Rhal personally led a massacre of the Octusi in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Arari]] when they refused to stop their revolt. Vaandt covered the event on live news, but Rhal found out and attacked her, shooting and killing her. However, Vaandt's assistant, [[Shohta Laar]], picked up where she left off, continuing the report and assisting in Rhal's capture by the arriving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]].<ref name="Vortex" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the "Blaudu Sextus system" mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Essential Atlas Online Companion'']] (in the Prefsbelt sector) was a mistake. Blaudu Sextus was in the [[Regulan system/Legends|Regulan system]], correctly listed in the appendix.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31605450|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=jasonfry|date=2011-03-19|time=7:30 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802124300/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-162}}</ref>
